a.xlink:title: bundle_copy: copied XPC bundle | the installer; the host, the worker and the validator, each with the build's signature until the installer re-signs them; CFBundleIdentifier is the service name

provenance: runner provenance and binary baselines | runner kind, service name, registry id, and the host's, the worker's and the validator's signatures and entitlements; hashes of the bundle's service, worker and validator files as observed before invocation
X15: Binaries::observe hashes the service, worker and validator files before invocation |
X15 hashes before invocation
entitlements_plist: the installer's entitlements plist | the installer; the host executable and the embedded worker, the process the policy is applied to

signing: codesign of the bundle tree | the embedded worker with the identity and the supplied entitlements, the validator with the identity alone, then the enclosing bundle with the identity and the entitlements; the sealed bundle recursively (--deep --strict) before anything is recorded
X3: supplied entitlements |
X3 entitlements

install: runner install | signs the worker, the validator and then the bundle, verifies the seal recursively, writes the launchd plist, bootstraps, records the runner with every binary's read-back; with --env, adds EnvironmentVariables
X4: sign_install_tree: codesign the worker with --entitlements, the validator, then the bundle; codesign --verify --deep --strict |
X4 codesign

plist: LaunchAgent or LaunchDaemon plist | MachServices, RunAtLoad, ProgramArguments with --mach-service, EnvironmentVariables from --env, ThrottleInterval of 1 second; the user's LaunchAgents or /Library/LaunchDaemons
X8: build_launchd_plist and write_launchd_plist |
X8 plist

registry: runner registry | pending, installed, pending_cleanup; service name, scope, bundle path, and the host's, the worker's and the validator's signatures and entitlements as read back separately, each entitlement set with its keys and the keys granted (value true)
X11: install_record: pending before the plist, installed after the bootstrap |
X11 record
host: PWRunner as a Mach service | NSXPCListener(machServiceName:) from --mach-service; the installed identity and entitlements; relative to its own bundle
X5: the host executable carries the identity and entitlements; read back by entitlements_from_codesign and codesign_metadata |
X5 signs the host

worker: pw-probe-runner in the copy | the installed identity and the supplied entitlements, signed before the bundle seal; the installed plist's entitlements; a require-entitlement rule consults this process
X6: the worker carries the identity and the supplied entitlements; read back by read_back |
X6 signs the worker
validator: sb_api_validator in the copy | the installed identity alone, no entitlements
X7: the validator carries the identity alone; read back by read_back |
X7 signs the validator
launchd: launchd | the host on demand for its Mach service; one launch per ThrottleInterval, 1 second in the generated plist; launchd's own default applies without the key
X9: launchctl bootstrap into the gui or system domain |
X9 bootstrap
X14: runner_provenance_from_target copies kind, service, id and each binary's signature and entitlements |
X14 provenance
X10: start on demand for the Mach service; one launch per ThrottleInterval (1 second) between launches |
X10 start on demand
X18: posix_spawn of the copy's own worker |
X18 spawn
X19: posix_spawn of the copy's own validator |
X19 spawn
client: pw-runner-client --mach-service | NSXPCConnection(machServiceName:), with the privileged option for system scope

caller_auth: caller authorization | the caller's Team ID equals the host's; an optional identifier allowlist; PWRunnerRequireSignedCaller and PWRunnerAllowedIdentifiers in the host's Info.plist, inherited by a copy
X16: NSXPCConnection(machServiceName:), privileged for system scope |
X16 connect
X17: shouldAcceptNewConnection: the caller's Team ID equals the host's, and the identifier allowlist if present |
X17 Team ID equal

selector: request runner selector | the runner by id or service, with mode and required_entitlements; every required key present with the value true in the worker's recorded read-back; the host's entitlements are recorded, not consulted; a record without a worker read-back is refused with a reinstall message when anything is required; before XPC delivery
X13: resolve by id or service; every required entitlement must be granted (value true) in the worker's recorded read-back |
X13 resolve

verify: runner verify | sends a fixed allow-all request through the client and waits 5,000 milliseconds by default; the host it reaches: an immediately following request meets that host's terminal claim (already_ran) or waits for the generated plist's 1 second ThrottleInterval; a refusal executed nothing and the request can be sent again
X20: a fixed allow-all request on the client's stdin |
X20 allow-all request

validate: runner validate | verifies each record's bundle recursively and the host, worker and validator individually, re-reads every signature and entitlement set, reports failures by record and binary; consults no launchctl
X21: verifies the bundle recursively and each binary on its own, re-reads every signature and entitlement set, reports failures |
X21 re-read
remove: runner remove | moves ownership to pending_cleanup, boots the service out, removes the plist, retires the record after verified absence
X23: pending_cleanup first; retired only after verified absence of service and plist |
X23 retire
X22: bootout, then re-read for up to 1,000 milliseconds of teardown |
X22 bootout
reconcile: runner reconcile | reports launchd services and plists that look owned, changing nothing
X25: inspect_plist lists candidate plists without changes |
X25 inspect
X24: inspect_service lists candidate services without changes |
X24 inspect
user: the installer | a person or a harness; a bundle copy, an identity, an entitlements plist, a scope
X1: copies the shipped PWRunner.xpc |
X1 copy
X2: runner install with --bundle, --identity, --entitlements, --scope and optional --env |
X2 argv
